limits: This is deterministic automated model verification, not human playtesting, real-device certification, or evidence of historical accuracy.
The selected histories use three fixed seeds, four build choices, and risky recruitment when a real post exists. Legal year20 actor plans at distinct cells are enumerated, including explicit passes.
Individual review contracts are retained; this check does not infer independence or combine their probabilities.
Optional surveyed veto, true legacy rules, unresolved drafts, and hidden-roll access are covered separately by tests/crisis-outlook.test.js.

tradeoffs.scope: Versioned workload audit of real natural player routes. Demonstrates sampled tradeoffs, not complete game balance or human playtesting. Synthetic maintenance and affordability states are labelled.
tradeoffs.meaning: 644 sampled crossing tradeoffs. balanced=false; not universal balance or human validation.

roles.scope: Ten natural role-allocation pairs plus two natural preparation branches. Not universal balance or human-playtest certification.
roles.interpretation: Work is not invalid or pointless. The protagonist alone owns the policy action. Choosing construction, training or a check instead can be deliberate, but needs to be explicit before investigation and submission.

limitations: No physical-device, screen-reader, human-play or global balance certification.
Baseline single-click return is not baseline repeated-input validation.

naturalCostSample.scope: 96 sampled four-window natural trajectories, three investigation variants at each planning checkpoint. Enumerated all lockable one/two-role arrangements within each sample; not all possible histories, seeds or investigation inventories. No low-balance injection.
